proposals.hypothesis: If shippingservice fails, the checkout journey will be blocked (because the shipping quote is required) and users will not be able to complete the checkout. Expected: high error rate in the checkout journey (50% or more).
proposals.reason: shippingservice is critical for the checkout journey (the most important for revenue) and we haven't run service-down on it.

proposals.hypothesis: If one pod of checkoutservice fails, the system will route requests to other pods (so the error rate might be low) but the checkout journey might be temporarily blocked. Expected: low error rate (10-20%) and slightly higher p95 latency.
proposals.reason: checkoutservice is critical for the checkout journey (the most important for revenue) and we have run service-down on it but not pod-kill.

proposals.hypothesis: If one pod of paymentservice fails, the checkout journey will be blocked at the payment step (so the user will see an error message) but the system might retry. Expected: small error rate (10-20%) and slightly higher p95 latency.
proposals.reason: paymentservice is critical for the checkout journey and we have run service-down on it but not pod-kill.
